warnings: All bars print ø -> type RB. No concrete strength, steel grade or cover is printed on this sheet.

Bent-up bars labelled '(คมL/5)' (คอม้า) are merged into main_bar.bottom with the printed text kept, following houses 129/157 (same สพฐ. drafting convention): B1, B2, B4, B5 bottom = 2 straight + 2 bent-up = 4; RB1 bottom = 2 + 1 bent-up = 3.
B3 prints a second '2-ø15มม' bottom label without the คม mark (the other beams carry it); both leaders reach the bottom cluster, so bottom = 4 and the entry is flagged.
S2 span is printed as the formula 'L=6.50/3' (three panels per A-B bay) — span_m = 2.167 with the printed text kept; that same formula positions the B4 lines A''/A''' in the grid master.

Lintel, sill, wall-post and ledge details carry no mark — element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). The sill beam prints one 2-ø9 row, so it keeps a single count instead of an invented top/bottom split. The ledge (บ่า) is built only when precast planks replace S2.
The beams B6 and B6' are detailed on S-07, not here; GB (S-01) has no section anywhere in the set.
